title: What's New: Shopify Connector (2024 release wave 2) in 2 minutes

chapters.title: Shopify Connector Overview and Meta Fields
Meta Fields and Language Translation Support

features.name: Meta Fields Import/Export
features.description: Import or export meta fields linked to products or variants in Shopify and use them for custom mappings between Shopify and Business Central.

features.name: Language Translation Synchronization
features.description: Synchronize translations with a new languages action by importing languages from Shopify and adding them to items in Business Central so the Shopify store can display product descriptions in different languages.

features.name: Company Catalogs Pricing Sync
features.description: Use company catalogs in Business Central to synchronize company-specific prices and discounts, ensuring each company sees their negotiated prices and discounts when they log into the Shopify store.

features.name: Customer-Specific Discounts and Orders
features.description: Assign specific discounts to individual customers in Business Central and create customer-specific orders in Shopify with personalized pricing.

features.name: Enhanced Shipping Fee Mapping
features.description: Map shipping fee information from Shopify to Business Central more accurately with flexibility to choose from different types of shipping charges such as item or order charges and specify shipping agent and service.

features.name: Shipping Methods in Sales Orders
features.description: Create sales orders in Business Central and see shipping charges and shipment methods such as agent and agent service directly in sales documents.

features.name: Payment Method Reconciliation
features.description: Reconcile transactions with different payment methods like gift cards and credit cards by posting receipt journals and reconciling transactions directly in Business Central.

features.name: Posted Sales Invoice Synchronization
features.description: Synchronize posted sales invoices to Shopify using filters to select invoices for specific customers and companies, allowing you to see orders in Shopify with payment and fulfillment status details.

quotes.text: the Shopify connector allows you to synchronize data such as items inventory and customers between Shopify and business Central
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the core purpose of the Shopify connector for data synchronization across platforms.

quotes.text: now you can import or export meta Fields linked to products or variants in Shopify and use them to do custom mappings
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights new capability for meta fields that enables flexible custom data mapping between systems.

quotes.text: with Shopify you can use company cataloges and business Central to synchronize company specific prices and discounts
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes new company-level pricing synchronization for multi-company scenarios.

quotes.text: you can now map shipping fee information from Shopify to business Central more accurately and with more flexibility
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates enhanced shipping fee mapping capabilities with more control and accuracy.

quotes.text: we've also added a new way to reconcile transactions with different payment methods like gift cards and credit cards
quotes.why_it_matters: Introduces new payment method reconciliation feature for diverse payment types.

quotes.why_it_matters: Announces new invoice synchronization capability with filtering options for targeted posting.
